name: Kanglelang
description: An Indonesian online auction and marketplace platform, serving around 470 active sellers and 2,200 paid orders a month.
highlights: Built and maintain the platform on Laravel 9 and MySQL, with a REST API serving the mobile app.
Designed the escrow payment flow on Xendit (QRIS and Virtual Account) with idempotent webhook handling, stock reservation, and automatic fund release on delivery confirmation.

Implemented the seller wallet as an internal ledger with automated payouts via the Xendit Disbursement API, using row-level locking and idempotency guards to prevent double-crediting and duplicate withdrawals.

Integrated multi-courier shipping (KiriminAja) and automated the order lifecycle: auto-refund on seller SLA breach, dispute resolution, and dangerous-goods detection that routes checkout to cargo services.
